=== bm1684x2 ===
commit f36a2e9fd70d328b1d99bd3ee6d34ac312459412
Author: zhejun.yang <zhejun.yang@sophgo.com>
Date:   Fri Sep 11 00:11:48 2026 +0800

    [fix][bm1684x2] cache 3 hot getenv in cmodel
    
    Layer-group compilation of an eva02_block on bm1684x2 spends ~58% of
    wall time in getenv: the RVT simulation layer re-reads env vars on
    every simulated instruction / command / issue_desc. None of the vars
    has a runtime producer.
    
    - rvt_sim.h INSTR_SAVE: one simulated instruction (one rvt_* hook)
      expands to 4 INSTR_SAVE macros, each calling getenv("DUMP_RVTI")
      (10.9B calls, 94.5%) -> rvti_dump_enabled() static inline
    - store_cmd.cpp get_atomic_cmodel_enable(): getenv("FORBID_CMD_EXECUTE")
      on every command (339M calls, 2.9%) -> static pointer cache
    - rvt_sim.c txp_flag(): getenv("TVGEN_USING_TXP") on every issue_desc
      (303M calls, 2.6%) -> static cached flag
    - after fix, ~72% of held-lock samples inside the real RVT-instrumented
      codegen chain (batch_matmul / quant_mm / tpu_bdc_cpy): the remaining
      bottleneck is the instruction simulation itself.
    - minor improve to cmodel_common.cpp and cmodel_arch.cpp
    
    Change-Id: Iba28fa09dbea21d821afa73e0e835fbc0b00b829
=== bm1684x ===
commit 4ab63b3c2e

=== bm1688 ===
commit 0994e837c0ab01c449de55b7f4365b5063287444
Author: yujia liu <yujia.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Tue Aug 11 10:33:34 2026 +0800

fix: support matmul+relu do_relu on bm1688

Extend the bm1684x matmul+relu fix to the bm1686 architecture (bm1688):
pass do_relu through the api and enable the fused per-channel requant
path (graceful-drop + requant_via_int16). Keep bias_dtype as FP32 on
bm1686 so the fp16 matmul path is unaffected.

Keep bm1688's native with_rq1 fast path (requant_mode<0/2/5, no izp)
for non-fused matmul, and keep its rzp_dtype as DT_INT16 (as before):
excluding bm1686 from with_rq1 or switching rzp to the input dtype both
broke bm1688 int8 matmul (wrong bmodel output / codegen crash). The
fused do_relu path (requant_mode==3) is unaffected.

Change-Id: I292db1a970000000000000000000000000000001
=== cv184x ===
commit b853c35aa6bbc6aa37676607bae9c94429694664
Author: yifan.chen <yifan.chen@sophgo.com>
Date:   Wed Jul 29 15:31:55 2026 +0800

    fix: handle non-integer offset in bm1684x2 requant mode==1
    
    - mode==1 perlayer path on BM1684X2/SG2262 now checks offset integrality;
      non-integer offset falls back to fp32 arithmetic (cast to FP32, fp_mul_C,
      fp_add_C, cast to top) so the fractional part participates in final rounding
    - global layer allocates FP32 buffer for mode==1 + non-integer offset on
      BM1684X2/SG2262, enabling the local-layer fallback
    
    Change-Id: I4cdbf568bae3501e5eba768a7faaf8ca21709c3d

=== bm1690 ===
commit 44b4477699e7487fa762d6b5622cbf3e7dfa3004
Author: junliang.liu <junliang.liu@sophgo.com>
Date:   Fri Aug 21 16:06:40 2026 +0800

    [fix][sg2262][tvgen] support TV_GEN_ENABLE_DENORMAL and TV_GEN_ENABLE_SATURATE together
    
    Previously the two env vars mapped to the same mutually-exclusive
    CORNER_LEVEL, so enabling both silently dropped saturate (denormal won),
    leaving param.saturate=1 paired with NaN/Inf inputs and causing miscompares.
    
    Add a dedicated ALL_COVER_SATURATE level that merges both distributions
    (denormal special values + extra MaxNormal weight for saturate). Only the
    combined branch is new; single-flag paths keep the exact same rand()
    sequence, so enabling only one flag reproduces the previous results
    bit-for-bit.
    
    Change-Id: I7d7e89b568426daad3c11e7233fac0993c5c85b5
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
